question: Why is the objection about returning after burning the bonds misplaced?
premises: The emanation is made pure by bringing it to non-difference through the power of installation.
This process concerns the shaking off of the burning of bonds.
Some deluded people object to this process.
inference: Because the rite establishes non-difference and purity, objections about reverting after the bonds are burned arise from misunderstanding.
uncertainties: The exact nuance of pāśadāhavidhūnane is compact; it is read as the removal that follows the burning of bonds.
plain_english: By the power and order of the installation, the emanation is brought to non-difference and made pure. Therefore those deluded people who object regarding the shaking off of the burning of bonds are mistaken.
